messages:
nora_ml: Posting a short debugging journal from the mid-day micro-canary: speculative stitching + q4-emul on ember-13b. fast wins on med/long tails, but we see concentrated exact-match/regression clusters for templated edits. saving the quick notes here so we don't lose context.

kevin_serving: please paste the tiny numbers you pulled so we can pick sweep ranges. rough is fine.

nora_ml: small CSV export from the harness:
```csv
variant,p50_ms,p95_ms,templated_exact_fail_pct,mean_top2_gap
baseline,130,360,0.4,2.3
spec+q4-emul,95,240,2.0,1.2
spec-only,102,260,0.6,2.2
q4-emul-only,125,330,1.0,1.6
```

tara_eval: looks like failures concentrate on short templated fills (dates, amounts, slot edits). diffs are mostly single-token swaps at commit boundary.

kevin_serving: two shards auto-rolled back; their KV hit-rate dipped around a GC spike. could be eviction-churn exposing stale prefetched KV to speculative stitch.

nora_ml: run config for the canary: `spec.stitch=true`, `spec.fill_ratio=0.65`, `spec.max_lookahead=3`, `quant.profile=q4-emul`, `kv.policy=adaptive_lru`.

tara_eval: hypothesis: q4-emul reduces top2 margin; speculative stitch commits on marginal margins -> slot token flips. we should measure commit_conf (top1 confidence) and top2_gap at commit and after quant kernel. also compute per-token flip-rate (fp32 ref vs quant kernel).

nora_ml: proposed next actions:
- Short A/B: spec+q4-emul vs q4-emul-only, bucketed by prompt shape: templated-short (<128), templated-long (128-512), conv-freeform
- Sweep `spec.fill_ratio` in [0.4,0.55,0.7] and `max_lookahead` in [1,3]
- Add q8-emul quick test as intermediate level to see whether errors scale with quant floor
- Instrument token-level histograms: top1_before, top2_before, top1_after_quant, flip_flag, token_id (sanitized). export numeric histograms only.
- Small adversarial templated set (300 cases) focusing punctuation/casing/whitespace near slots.

kevin_serving: also check whether commit happens pre- or post-normalization (we've seen punctuation/spacing flips if commit is before canonicalization). ensure commit trace includes pre/post normalized token.

nora_ml: good catch, will add pre/post normalization snapshots to traces. all logs will be token id + numeric diffs only (no free-text).

ops-bot: Job `spec-stitch-q4-scan-319200` created by nora_ml. shards: 12, staggered start in ~90m.

ci-bot: Reminder: keep RNG seeds fixed across variants to isolate quant/spec interactions. Artifacts should be scrubbed: token ids and numeric metrics only.

tara_eval: when we analyze, compare both BLEU-style and exact-match metrics; BLEU can hide single-token failures on short templated outputs. add an exact-match gate for templated suite.

nora_ml: will update the harness PR with the instrumentation and adversarial set, tag @tara_eval and @kevin_serving for review. planning to post sanitized summaries here after runs finish.

kevin_serving: thanks. if q8-emul reduces flip-rate dramatically, we should prioritize refining quant kernels or fallback to q8 on templated-heavy routes.

nora_ml: agreed. reconvene after job completes.
